caption: La Nave di Cascella and pier, Pescara
composition: White Cascella ship fountain on the sandy Adriatic beach beside the long pier · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The tourist stands on the wide sandy beach facing the white ship sculpture of La Nave di Cascella on its stepped plinth to the left, with the long pier stretching right across the turquoise Adriatic. Gentle waves lap the shore in the foreground while the town skyline runs along the distant coast under a blue sky of scattered cloud. The 14:25 afternoon sun is bright, and the sea shades from aqua at the shore to deep blue beyond the pier.
